## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the problem and what this change makes possible. Link the related issue if one exists.

## Changes

Describe the changes a reviewer needs to understand. Identify any change to documentation policy explicitly.

## Verification

State what you checked, the observed result, and relevant host versions. For wording-only edits, explain how you checked that the meaning was preserved.

## Limitations

State remaining uncertainty or unverified behavior. Write "None identified" if applicable.
